dtype_policy.defaults: Python bool/int/float/complex dtype arguments select config-dependent default types. enable_x64=False gives int32/uint32/float32/complex64 defaults; True gives corresponding64/128 defaults.
dtype_policy.explicit_x64: With enable_x64=False, jax_explicit_x64_dtypes=WARN(default) warns+canonicalizes int64,uint64,float64,complex128 down; ERROR raisesValueError; ALLOW respects explicit wide dtype. enable_x64=True respects explicit dtype in all three modes.
dtype_policy.promotion: jax_numpy_dtype_promotion STANDARD/STRICT and weak Python scalars matter where result_type is used; do not substitute NumPy promotion.

dtype_candidates.critical_limit: Valid dtype parsing is NOT operation/backend support. String, float0, extended types and low-bit arithmetic each need per-operation/device admissibility or typed-rejection source/oracle evidence; these are open obligations, never excluded or counted as success.

common_contract.shape_domain: Finite rank>=0 shape tuples of nonnegative integer dimensions, scalar integer length, and concrete scalar/1D integer-array shape forms supported by canonicalize_shape. Include (),0,(0,),(2,0,3),(1,),(2,3), symbolic dimension expressions where exported shape-polymorphic primitive supports them; negative/noninteger/nonconcrete forms require exact errors.
common_contract.layout_policy: No order/strides argument in these seven APIs; JAX value arrays are immutable. Test scalar/broadcasted/noncontiguous host or JAX inputs where accepted, output value-index mapping and sharding. Physical device layout remains compiler/backend-qualified; do not invent ndarray alias/mutation behavior.
execution: jvp/vjp/grad where input domain is differentiable
nested vmap-jit-grad with static output shape
common_contract.oracle_environment: Freeze JAX0.12.0.1 plus selected jaxlib, ml_dtypes, NumPy, SciPy and device plugins/driver/compiler flags. JAX release permitsjaxlib0.11.2..0.12.0.1,ml_dtypes>=0.5.0; optional plugins alter dtype/device surface. Exact versions/hashes remain a definition prerequisite.
common_contract.precision_rule: Derive bounds from conditioning and represented arithmetic/declared computation dtype. Integer/index/shape invariants require exact values. Inexact fixtures list mathematical targets; conditioning-derived bounds and reference arithmetic policy must be finalized before execution. Exact representability of a target alone does not remove intermediate-rounding error. Never copy the reference test suite's ad-hoc relaxed epsilon as proof; native source tests include skipped/narrowed cases and are not full acceptance evidence.
common_contract.cross_framework_dedup: Keep all public API identities and JAX policy variants. Same internal target/name or NumPy-like signature does not prove equivalent errors/defaults/device/AD semantics.
